notes: The five patches restore the exact source commit and tree with the provided build helper.
The source archive preserves upstream licenses and source notices.
Toolchains and build dependencies are fetched using the pinned public manifest; prebuilt toolchain binaries are not embedded in the source archive.
Rebuilds generate fresh module signing material. Rebuilt signatures and final hashes may differ; private release keys are not distributed.
packaging/package.py produces three kernel cohort images from qualified stock inputs and a user-provided AVB key. Release parent AVB images must be rebuilt consistently before installation.

Packaging was host-tested with retained K4 kernel/modules and a temporary AVB key. Retained auxiliary file hashes and types are checked before copying; same-size, same-mtime tamper tests pass. No hardware boot or byte-identical new-key signature claim.
